instruction: Given the current mission context, what should the UAV do next? Choose the best action.

context.mission: Proceed from waypoint WP1 to waypoint WP2 while maintaining safe operation.
a2a_interactions: UAV-2: Battery low, returning to base.

candidates.label: A
candidates.description: Keep the current path and proceed.

candidates.label: B
candidates.description: Climb to a higher altitude and continue.

candidates.label: C
candidates.description: Compute an alternative safe path around the obstacle.

candidates.label: D
candidates.description: Abort the mission and return to base.

rationale: The obstacle blocks the current path and the strong crosswind increases collision risk. The UAV has enough battery and valid sensor observations, so replanning is the safest action that allows the mission to continue.
